newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemalan lawmaker and nephew murdered.
newsitem.headline: Guatemalan lawmaker and nephew murdered.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen murdered a lawmaker from the majority National Advancement Party (PAN) and his seven-year-old nephew in the city of Escuintla, police said on Saturday.
"He was riddled with bullets returning from an evangelical church. We don't know the motive," police spokesman Simon Borror said.
Congressman Joel Salomon Mendoza Pineda, 43, and his nephew, Adin Anibal Martinez Mendoza, were gunned down late on Friday from a passing car carrying four or five people, witnesses said.
Abraham Rivera, PAN party secretary general, said he did not rule out that the murder was a political assassination.
"I heard that he had received death threats, but no one took that seriously. He was never a man of conflict. No one could imagine he had enemies," Rivera said.
Mendoza was a farmer and had held several government posts including mayor of Escuintla, the city he represented in Congress since January last year.
The PAN is the party of President Alvaro Arzu, who has held office for one year and has a majority in Guatemala's one-house legislature.
